answer: Stake 100 POA per review and spot-check 1 in 10. Void the whole review when its panel is not diverse, meaning 2 seats from one operator. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so a replay is rejected before scoring. A willow of 400 aliases that wander onto the same panel lose their stake on the first void, and a juniper row of lookalike reviewers fails the same rule at seat 2. The number that matters is 1 upheld check per 10.
